name: Shattering-Extremal Equality
statement: A family $H\subseteq 2^X$ is ample when $\operatorname{sstr}(H)=\operatorname{str}(H)$, where $\operatorname{str}(H)$ and $\operatorname{sstr}(H)$ are its shattered and strongly shattered coordinate sets.
comments: The terms lopsided and shattering-extremal are synonymous with ample in this formulation.
